name: Travelling Trails - Phase 7 Staging Review Handoff

parameters.jsCode: const runId=$json.runId || $env.TT_PHASE7_RUN_ID; if(!/^tt-[0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{16}$/.test(runId||'')) throw new Error('TT_PHASE7_RUN_ID required'); return [{json:{runId}}];

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json;if(r.action==='DEPLOY_WAITING') throw new Error('Staging deploy not ready yet');if(!r.reviewPayload||r.reviewPayload.published!==false||r.reviewPayload.branch!=='Staging') throw new Error('Unsafe Phase 7 review payload');return [{json:r.reviewPayload}];
